GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back to last 5l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, ran on well making good ground # good 4 further
Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 12 lengths. well back turn. ran on strongly along fence # too far back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider pleaded guilty to a charge under AR132(7)(a)(i) in that, approaching the 150m, he used his whip on two consecutive strides.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down well back 5 lengths. well back turn getting up fence. ran on well # slow away

Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field Four Wide No Cover (3L from lead). Worked to hold ground 3 Wide With Cover midrace & pushed to quicken3W (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & chased steadily in last 200m. # Wide/tried hard.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over-raced when obliged to race four-wide in the early to middle stages before being eased to obtain cover three-wide after the 800m allowing the gelding to race in a more settled fashion.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 2 lengths. 2nd turn getting off leaders back 2 lengths. battled away # Every Chance
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 3 lengths. got to outside turn hard ridden3 lengths. battled away # Even Effort
Jumped Fair Settled Down near rear Inside 9-10l Straightened Up same Dropped Right Out , abnormal # respiratory noise
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out near the 600m and eased down from the 250m. Rider reported an abnormal respiratory noise. Vet: no significant findings. Warning issued for poor performance.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to front. led turn. weakened # Every Chance
Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 5 lengths. under pressure turn 5 lengths. battled away # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On return to scale rider reported that her mount dipped passing the 700m and she expressed concern regarding the footing around that section of the track. After inspecting that section of the track with Stewards, no safety concerns were identified.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 2nd 1 length. 2nd turn. battled away # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After the 50m, rider’s helmet slipped forward obstructing her vision requiring her very momentarily to have to use her right hand to adjust her helmet’s position.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went through on fence to lead. led turn giving good kick. weakened in Straight # Every Chance
Slow Out 1 length worked around to lead. led turn. found plenty in Straight . slow away # strong win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding leading the event rider stated her instructions were to get her mount to travel out of the barriers but not necessarily lead the event, as in previous starts the gelding has failed to muster early speed. However, after being a little slow to begin, she rode her mount along from the barriers and rather than being caught wide and without cover allowed her mount to stride forward and lead. Her explanation was noted.
